headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, driven by AI and strong deal wins.
summary: Most listed firms reported double‑digit YoY revenue growth. AI‑related sales were highlighted by TCS, HCLTech, LTM and Wipro. Deal wins in the US exceeded $9 bn for TCS. Profit trends were mixed, with Persistent seeing a sharp profit decline despite revenue expansion.

themes.title: AI‑driven services
themes.detail: AI revenue grew sharply across several firms, becoming a key growth driver.

themes.title: Large US deal wins
themes.detail: US‑based contracts contributed significant new revenue, especially for TCS.
